origin.prompt: Flat, modern, minimalist app icon artwork for a local knowledge-graph desktop application. Perfectly centered bold geometric monogram letter H. The mark is large and occupies the central 62 percent of the canvas height. Very simple shapes, strong silhouette, crisp clean vector edges, must stay legible at 16 pixels. No glow, no bevel, no glass, no 3D, no reflections, no texture, no noise. The H is made of exactly three thick pill-shaped strokes with fully rounded ends. The two tall vertical pillars are pure solid white. The crossbar is one thick solid warm amber #FFB020 horizontal pill, perfectly level, slightly overlapping both pillars and drawn on top of them, with a thin gap in the background colour separating it from the white pillars. Symmetrical. Background: smooth diagonal gradient from deep midnight indigo #0B1140 at the bottom left to vivid electric blue #2F6BFF at the top right. The background fills the entire square image edge to edge, all the way into every corner. No rounded corners, no border, no frame, no app icon container, no drop shadow, no device mockup, no text, no extra letters, no watermark.

transformation: source.png is the generated output, byte for byte; scripts/generate_icons.py applies the crop, continuous-corner mask, shadow and Lanczos resize
